backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a favorites list with add, remove, and query functions, storing title/URL pairs in a mutable list.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming high-confidence implementation of 10 new wallpaper options added to PersonalizationPanel, usePersonalization hook, and Personalization page.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of frontend source file paths to short descriptions summarizing each component, page, hook, and data file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with a root div and module script entry point for the Kitsch-io React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Query and TanStack Router with routes for Home, Games, Movies, and Music pages under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/GameCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a game's title, category badge, description, and a Play Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout shell managing the personalization hook, fixed background/overlay layers, header navigation, and a Style button that opens the PersonalizationPanel.
frontend/src/components/MovieCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a movie's title, year, genre badge, synopsis, and a Watch Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/PersonalizationP: Modal overlay panel that renders all 20 wallpaper options as thumbnails in a grid, plus an overlay darkness slider, accepting a personalization hook prop to apply changes.
frontend/src/components/ShowCard.tsx: Reusable card component for anime/drama shows displaying title, episode count, genre badge, description, and a Watch Now link with configurable accent color.
frontend/src/components/TrackCard.tsx: A React component that displays a music track card with title, artist, genre badge, an HTML audio player, and an optional source link.
frontend/src/components/widgets/ClockWid: A widget component that shows a live-updating digital clock with hours, minutes, seconds, and the current date, updating every second via an interval.
frontend/src/components/widgets/Favorite: A widget that displays a user's saved favorite links fetched via React Query hooks, with the ability to add new favorites or remove existing ones.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MoodBoar: A widget that lets users select and persist a current mood (emoji + label) from a predefined list, storing the selection in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MusicTic: A static widget that displays a horizontally scrolling ticker of hardcoded classical music track names with a CSS animation.
frontend/src/data/anime.ts: Exports a typed array of anime show objects (title, episodes, genre, description, watchUrl) covering classic and older anime series with Archive.org links.
frontend/src/data/c-drama.ts: Exports a typed array of Chinese drama show objects with metadata and Viki watch links, covering historical, fantasy, and wuxia genres.
frontend/src/data/games.ts: Exports a typed array of classic DOS/NES game objects with category, description, and Archive.org URLs, spanning action, platformer, and shooter genres.
frontend/src/data/j-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Japanese drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/k-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Korean drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and watch URLs across Viki, Netflix, and Kocowa.
frontend/src/data/movies.ts: Defines a Movie interface and exports a large array of movies spanning multiple eras, each with title, year, genre, synopsis, and Internet Archive watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/music.ts: Defines a Track interface and exports an array of public domain classical and orchestral music tracks with artist, genre, and Internet Archive audio/source URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChat.ts: Custom React hook managing chat state for an AI assistant named Kitschy, handling message history, sending messages via an AI service, loading state, and error handling with a clearHistory utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/usePersonalization.ts: Custom hook that manages user background texture and overlay opacity preferences, persisting settings to localStorage with a predefined list of valid textures.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and removing user favorites via an ICP actor, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for a dark theme color system, and styles scrollbars and audio elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AIAssistant.tsx: Chat UI page featuring a Kitschy AI assistant with message bubbles, a loading indicator, and keyboard-accessible input using the useChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Anime.tsx: Anime browsing page with search and genre filter controls that display filtered anime show cards from a static data source.
frontend/src/pages/CDrama.tsx: C-Drama browsing page with search and genre filter controls that display filtered Chinese drama show cards from a static data source.
frontend/src/pages/Games.tsx: Displays a searchable, filterable grid of 20 browser-based games (with categories like Puzzle, Arcade, Strategy) using a GameCard component and category/search state.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page for KitschHub showing a hero section, banner image, and three navigation cards linking to the Games, Movies, and Music sections.
frontend/src/pages/JDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Japanese drama series with search and genre filter controls, rendering results in a grid of ShowCard components using j-drama data.
frontend/src/pages/KDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Korean drama series with search and genre filter controls, rendering results in a grid of ShowCard components using k-drama data.
frontend/src/pages/Movies.tsx: Movies browsing page with search, genre, and decade filters over a public-domain movie dataset, displaying results in a responsive MovieCard grid.
frontend/src/pages/Music.tsx: Music page listing public-domain audio tracks (classical, jazz, ragtime, etc.) from archive.org with search and genre filtering, rendered via TrackCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx: Defines the Personalization page UI, listing all available background texture options (with thumbnails, labels, and descriptions) and using the usePersonalization hook to let users select and apply a wallpaper.
frontend/src/services/aiService.ts: Implements the AI chat service by sending prompts to the Mistral-7B model via Hugging Face Inference API, with a keyword-based fallback response function if the API call fails.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, display/sans font families, zero border-radius defaults, silver box shadows, and the animate and typography plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state including architecture notes, existing features, known issues, and image asset requirements for the Y2K-inspired entertainment hub.
